investigation.likely_cause: /data on the Subscriber DB server srv-db-01 is 100% full, mostly from the transaction log archive (/data/txlog_archive, 8.5 GiB). 8.5 GiB was written in 34 files within the last 15 minutes, which points to a catch-up run writing archives back rather than normal database growth. The database refuses writes below 256 MiB free, so write errors occurred on all schemas. The API errors, USSD gateway timeouts, failed synthetic sessions and SMS queue growth are downstream symptoms.
